title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-20

ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix recording capturing a high‑energy Garden show with a scorching Shakedown Street opener, blazing Dupree’s Diamond Blues and tight second‑set gems.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its nonstop fire—from Brent Mydland’s playful keyboards that set the tone on Shakedown Street to a jaw‑dropping Dupree's Diamond Blues and an inspired Spanish Jam > Truckin' > Other One sequence. Reviewers note the matrix blend gives crystal‑clear board detail with audience ambience, making every moment—from Scarlet/Fire to Terrapin Station—feel vivid and immediate.

ai_rating.rationale: All seven reviews are overwhelmingly positive (six 5‑star, one 4‑star) and highlight both an outstanding performance and superb matrix sound quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe crisp board clarity combined with audience energy; no significant dropouts or muddiness mentioned.

standout_songs: Spanish Jam > Truckin' > The Other One
Scarlet Begonias > Fire on the Mountain
show_quality.setlist_flow: Opening with a high‑octane Shakedown Street sets a charged tone; second set delivers tight, seamless transitions and strong jams, keeping momentum throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His strumming on Good Times is singled out for excellence; overall guitar work praised throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland is highlighted as 'right on target' and leading the band with playful, energetic keyboards.
